info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts StorageBuckets API

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to narrow results (e.g., State eq 'Running')

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 100, max 1000)

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieves a list of storage buckets defined in the current folder. Storage buckets provide file storage capabilities for automation processes, backed by providers such as Azure Blob, Amazon S3, or the UiPath internal storage.
